title: Design System: SaQreeZ Demon List (Cyberpunk Neon Vault)

display.purpose: Main level headers and primary page titles.

title.purpose: Card titles, score values, and group labels.

title-md.purpose: Medium section headers and uppercase stats.

label.purpose: List items, navigation tabs, buttons, and badges.

label-md.purpose: Author credits, secondary notes, and FPS badges.

label-sm.purpose: Micro tags and mobile meta badges.

shadows.name: neon-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient glow for active surfaces, buttons, and video showcases.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Smooth deceleration for micro-lifts, tabs, and panel reveals.

components.name: Primary Neon Button
components.description: Luminous action button with violet glow and tactile micro-lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-neon { background: #8d2be2; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'Lexend Deca', sans-serif; font-size: 17.14px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-neon:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.55); background: #a83dff; }

components.name: Obsidian Glass Row
components.description: Frosted glass level row with podium rank badge support.
components.css: .ds-glass-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(24, 26, 38, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Lexend Deca', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-glass-row:hover { background: rgba(34, 37, 54, 0.85); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.3); } .ds-glass-row--active { background: #8d2be2 !important; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.35); } .ds-rank--gold { color: #ffd166; font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.5); }

components.name: Copy Stat Card
components.description: Interactive card displaying level ID or password with one-click copy feedback.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(24, 26, 38, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); font-family: 'Lexend Deca', sans-serif; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11.4px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; } .ds-copy-btn { font-size: 11.4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.2); color: #a83dff; border: 1px solid rgba(168, 61, 255, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-copy-btn:hover { background: #a83dff; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: SaQreeZ Demon List (SDL) is reimagined as an electric, high-performance competitive vault for Geometry Dash challenge grinders and list verifiers. The visual world is defined by deep obsidian canvases (#0b0c10), frosted glass containers (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)), vibrant electric violet accents (#a83dff / #8d2be2), luminous ambient glows, and prestigious gold/silver/bronze podium distinctions.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Glass Foundations: Translucent acrylic panels with subtle 1px border illumination (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) and deep obsidian depth.
Electric Violet Luminescence: Vibrant purple energy accents powering active list selections, glowing button triggers, and interactive tabs.
Podium Prestige Hierarchy: Top 3 ranks claim dedicated metallic styling (#1 Gold #ffd166, #2 Silver #e0e1dd, #3 Bronze #cd7f32) elevating tournament prestige.
Precision Typography: Clean geometric rhythm powered by Lexend Deca with custom cap-height alignment.

rules.name: The Podium Distinction Rule
rules.body: Ranks #1, #2, and #3 are visually distinct from the rest of the list, proudly donning metallic gold, silver, and bronze badges to honor the hardest accomplishments in the game.

rules.name: The Obsidian Glass Rule
rules.body: Panels float over deep obsidian space using frosted translucency (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)) and subtle illuminated 1px borders, creating sophisticated depth without heavy opaque drop shadows.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: All ranks, points, completion percentages, FPS counters, and level IDs employ font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for rock-solid tabular alignment.

dos: Do use Lexend Deca with tabular-nums for all stats, numbers, and headers.
Do preserve the frosted obsidian glass aesthetics (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)).
Do honor top-3 podium styling (#1 Gold, #2 Silver, #3 Bronze) across List and Leaderboard.
Do provide instant visual feedback on one-click copy actions for IDs and passwords.
donts: Don't use opaque flat 2020-era tables without glass depth or rounded row treatments.
Don't use multi-color rainbow gradient borders that distract from competitive content.
Don't hide YouTube video embeds behind modal dialogs when direct inline playback is expected.
